title: eludite/codeLens/refresh (host to shell)
description: Brief 0052: the language server sent workspace/codeLens/refresh (its lenses changed, for example reference counts after an edit in another document). The host answers the server null at once and tells the shell with this notification; the shell requests textDocument/codeLens again for its open documents' visible ranges. eluditeGeneration is the generation current when the refresh arrived; the shell ignores one for another generation.
